name: Montréal Best of the Best — Berri-UQAM few-hours loop

properties.name: BEST OF MONTRÉAL — Berri-UQAM Loop
properties.desc: Approx. 8.5 km; allow roughly 3–4 hours with short stops.

properties.name: START / FINISH — Berri-UQAM
properties.desc: Best transit hub; start the loop here.

properties.name: HOTSPOT 01 — Square Saint-Louis
properties.desc: Classic Montréal: colourful Victorian houses, trees, Plateau atmosphere.

properties.name: HOTSPOT 02 — Rue Prince-Arthur
properties.desc: Pedestrian-scale Montréal streetscape and a quick gateway toward the Plateau.

properties.name: HOTSPOT 03 — The Main / Saint-Laurent
properties.desc: Montréal's cultural spine; murals, storefronts and layered immigrant history.

properties.name: HOTSPOT 04 — Place des Festivals
properties.desc: The visual heart of the Quartier des spectacles.

properties.name: HOTSPOT 05 — Chinatown
properties.desc: Compact, atmospheric detour through Montréal's Chinatown.

properties.name: HOTSPOT 06 — Place d'Armes
properties.desc: One of the strongest architectural views in the city.

properties.name: HOTSPOT 07 — Notre-Dame Basilica
properties.desc: Montréal icon; exterior is on-route, interior if time allows.

properties.name: HOTSPOT 08 — Place Jacques-Cartier
properties.desc: The classic public square of Old Montréal.

properties.name: HOTSPOT 09 — Marché Bonsecours
properties.desc: Landmark silver dome and one of Old Montréal's signature façades.

properties.name: HOTSPOT 10 — Clock Tower / St. Lawrence
properties.desc: River panorama and a strong sense of Montréal as a port city.

properties.name: HOTSPOT 11 — Old Port waterfront
properties.desc: Best section for a quick riverfront walk.

properties.name: HOTSPOT 12 — Place d'Youville
properties.desc: Excellent historic streetscape; quieter counterpoint to Place Jacques-Cartier.

properties.name: HOTSPOT 13 — Village / Sainte-Catherine Est
properties.desc: Distinctive central Montréal street life before returning to Berri-UQAM.
